# Hi, I'm Frederic OKE-AGBO.

I'm an actuary at SCOR, where I model mortality, longevity and policyholder
behavior risks. My path runs from statistics through public health to
actuarial science and machine learning. Here I share what I learn along the
way, through tutorials, notes and experiments for peers who want to learn
it faster.
